title: Petra and the Inheritance
author: Elodie Voss
blurb: Wren Ishikawa, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
